verdict.rationale: Kick's docs say you can create and send invoices directly from Kick and view invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL. AR is listed in the Plus plan. Nothing in the pack shows invoices carrying online payment options, or Kick tracking when an invoice is viewed or paid. missing for 10: online payment options on invoices, viewed/opened tracking, paid-status tracking, in-depth invoicing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: View invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL, and create and send invoices directly from Kick.
Plus — $100/mo — Unlimited entities, classes, accrual ledger, AR & AP
